infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: eBike uses the camera to capture photos inside the app before you publish them.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: eBike accesses your photo library to let you choose media that appears in the app.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: eBike uses your location to display your position on in-app maps and surface nearby points of interest.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: eBike needs background location while you are marked available so customers can find you when the app is in the background.
